body:
In article <tNVN4.6583$NS6.173698@news.globetrotter.net>,
  "Fischer" <gibby@globetrotter.net> wrote:
> From Jewwatch:
> "(...) ...in a recent Premiere magazine "Special Power Issue" -
ranking the 100
> most powerful people in the "Industry" - the top 12 were Jewish.
> ...

> The top 12 most powerful people in the entertainment industry are
> Jewish...
> While that figure in itself looks impressive, it becomes even more
> astonishing when one calculates the probability of such an occurrence.
> Assuming that Jews represent 2.7% of the American population, the
> odds of
> them occupying the top 12 spots in show biz the are 1 in
> 6,662,463,305,375,666,855. ...
> For those who think that this post is off-topic, here's some food for
> thought:
>
> "96. The mass media are mostly under the control of large
> organizations that
> are integrated into the system. Anyone who has a little money can have
> something printed, ...
> but what he has to say will be swamped by the vast volume of material
> put
> out by the media, hence it will have no practical effect. To make an
> impression on society with words is therefore almost impossible for
> most
> individuals and small groups.

Assuming that TK is the author and that he committed the acts
attributed to him including those to which he plead guilty, it seems to
me that paragraph 96 might be an attempt, in part, to explain why he
viewed a societal dialogue concerning the societal threat he perceived
useless.  Moreover, why he felt violence necessary.  What I can't see
is that Jewish folks were of any concern to him.  He doesn't take issue
with WHO is in control.  Rather, he takes issue with the fact that an
individual, ANY individual, is made powerless (devalued, dehumanized,
ultimately exterminated) by the facts he puts forth.


> 147. Then there are the methods of propaganda, for which the mass
> communication media provide effective vehicles. Efficient techniques
> have been developed for winning elections, selling products,
> influencing public opinion. The entertainment industry serves as an
> important psychological tool of the system, possibly even when it is
> dishing out large amounts of sex and violence.

Yes.  But again, assuming that TK is the author and that he committed
the acts attributed to him including those to which he plead guilty, it
seems to me that WHO controls is NOT at issue.  In other words, he puts
forth no beef against Jewish folks.  Rather, the impact upon society as
a whole and upon ANY individual specifically is of concern to him.  He
doesn't care WHO is producing and distributing the products.  He cares
about the negative consequences upon society and the individual he
perceives associated with the products.  As I understand it, he
perceives the entertainment industry as a tool which, whether
intentionally or unintentionally, ultimately chips away at our thought
processes.  We become about as passive as a sponge.  We become a
receptor.  First we lose our desire to think for ourself as it becomes
more fun to accept that which is coming at us from all angles.  Then,
we lose our capacity for individual thought.


> 28. The leftist of the oversocialized type ...
> Examples: racial equality, equality of the sexes,
> helping poor people, peace as opposed to war, nonviolence generally,
> freedom of expression, kindness to animals. More fundamentally, the
> duty of the individual to serve society and the duty of society to
> take care of the individual. ... These values are
> explicitly or implicitly expressed or presupposed in most of the
> material presented to us by the MAINSTREAM COMMUNICATIONS MEDIA and
> the educational system. ...
>
> --TK

SO?  Assuming that TK is the author and that he committed the acts
attributed to him including those to which he plead guilty, it seems to
me that, again, the issue is one of values and the overwhelming ability
of a particular group to impose its will upon the rest of society in a
manner that threatens the very life, liberty and soul of the individual
who falls outside the controlling values.  He doesn't give a hoot WHO
is in control, or what religion they embrace.  The fact, if its a fact,
that Jewish folks are the ones currently in a position to pose the
threat he concerns himself with is totally irrelevant.
